legal_act_name_ai_act: Regulation (EU) 2024/1689 laying down harmonised rules on artificial intelligence (Artificial Intelligence Act)
legal_act_name_guidelines: Guidelines or opinion of a supervisory authority
role_provider: develops an AI system or has it developed and places it on the market or puts it into service under its own name
role_deployer: uses an AI system under its own authority, except in a personal non-professional activity
role_importer: places on the Union market an AI system from a third country
role_distributor: makes an AI system available in the supply chain without being its provider or importer
role_product_manufacturer: integrates an AI system as a safety component into its own product and places it on the market under its own name
role_authorised_representative: acts in the Union on behalf of a provider established in a third country
role_data_subject: is affected by an AI system without operating it
risk_class_prohibited: prohibited AI practice — the system must not be operated this way
risk_class_high_risk_annex_i: high risk through product safety law (Annex I)
risk_class_high_risk_annex_iii: high risk through the area of use (Annex III)
risk_class_high_risk_exemption: falls under Annex III, but the derogation under Article 6(3) applies — registration required
risk_class_gpai_systemic_risk: general-purpose AI model with systemic risk
risk_class_minimal: no specific obligations apart from AI literacy under Article 4
risk_class_unclear: the information is not sufficient for a classification
